children: Overview
UK scientific instruments group's H1 revenue fell 21% amid challenging end markets
Adjusted pre-tax profit dropped 75% as cost cuts only partly offset lower volumes
Company maintained full-year earnings guidance and raised interim dividend by 10%
Outlook
Judges Scientific maintains 2026 guidance for adjusted EPS in line with market expectations of 200.5p
Company expects no Geotek coring expedition revenue in 2027; consensus adjusted EPS seen at 224.9p
Company says US research funding environment remains challenging; signs of improvement in China procurement
Result Drivers
MARKET HEADWINDS - Reduced US research funding, delays in China procurement, and offshore wind weakness weighed on H1 performance
BUSINESS GROWTH IN SELECT SECTORS - Eight businesses grew, supported by operational initiatives and healthier conditions in semiconductors and battery development
